longbench_v2.note: BASE model, from DeepSeek-V4 card comparison

swe_bench_pro.note: from HF eval-results sidebar; provenance unclear

metricInfo.mmlu_pro: Multiple-choice questions (10 options) across 14 subjects, from law and medicine to economics and engineering. Measures general knowledge and reasoning. Best for chatbots and general-purpose assistants.
metricInfo.gpqa_diamond: 198 PhD-level questions in physics, chemistry and biology, written so they cannot be solved by searching the web. Measures expert reasoning. Best for reasoning models.
metricInfo.longbench_v2: 503 multiple-choice questions over very long texts (documents, code, dialogues, tables), from 8 thousand to 2 million words. Measures long-context understanding. Best for summarization and document Q&A.
metricInfo.aa_lcr: Artificial Analysis Long Context Reasoning: questions that require cross-referencing several real documents, about 100 thousand tokens in total. Best for RAG and document analysis.
metricInfo.browsecomp: Hard questions whose answer must be found by browsing many web pages. Measures search and tool use. Best for research agents and agentic RAG.
metricInfo.swe_bench_verified: 500 real issues from Python projects on GitHub, human-verified: the model must write a patch that makes the tests pass. Best for agentic coding.
metricInfo.swe_bench_pro: Longer, more complex issues, in several languages and also on non-public repositories, so less exposed to contamination. Best for agentic coding on enterprise codebases.
metricInfo.terminal_bench_2_0: Real tasks to complete in a terminal: building, configuring services, debugging, processing data. Best for agents that work in the shell and DevOps.

chat.label: Chatbot
chat.hint: Multi-turn conversation: the chat history is resent every turn, so much of the prompt is already cached.

rag.label: Document Q&A
rag.hint: RAG: question plus retrieved chunks, short answer. System prompt and popular documents partly shared.

summary.label: Document summarization
summary.hint: Summaries of long documents uploaded by users: heavy prefill, little reuse across requests.

docgen.label: Document generation
docgen.hint: Drafting reports, long emails, documentation: short prompt, long output, decode-bound.

reasoning.label: Reasoning
reasoning.hint: Thinking models: the reasoning chain produces thousands of tokens before the answer.

completion.label: Code completion
completion.hint: IDE completion: a few lines per answer, very low perceived latency, open files almost always cached.

agentic.label: Agentic coding
agentic.hint: Agents that reread the repository and session history every turn: long context, high KV cache reuse.

benchNote: Scores published by vendors or by NVIDIA on the model cards (collected 2026-10-17). Harnesses and reasoning settings differ across labs, so cross-family comparisons are indicative. Models without a simulation are listed by accuracy but have no curves.
